terra.problem: The passage does not teach that God lays a work on every reader’s heart or that He never reveals the whole task at once. Most of the paragraph also retells Nehemiah’s actions rather than explaining their significance.
The statement that everyone had just the stretch in front of their own house overstates the passage. Only some repaired near their homes, and several repaired more than one section.

Nehemiah did address whose city it was: he told the mockers they had no portion, right, or claim in Jerusalem. His confidence that God would grant success to this rebuilding project is also presented too broadly as a guarantee for readers’ work.
